steps.text: Wire every grid/table and tab group to read them, and add a CI check against hard-coded colours. Per-instance overrides with Restore previous edit / Restore from axHub. Full API. Tests, help, Shipped features. Fable for the token schema.

Today grids only have layout tokens (--fx-grid-areas/cols/rows and the -m mobile variants), and tab groups only have --fx-tab-py/--fx-tab-px padding and --fx-tabs-per-row. Both borrow the general colour tokens (--fx-surface, --fx-border, accent), so hover, selected and active states can't be styled on their own. Add dedicated token families in tokens.style, following skins and editable in Token Control, the UI Manager and per instance.

GRID: header background/text/border/sort arrow/filter chip; row, alternate row, hover, selected, focused, expanded, disabled; grid lines, outer border, cell padding, row height, radius; group header, sticky column shadow, empty state; transparency (default 100%).

TAB GROUP: bar background and border; tab text, background and border for idle, hover, active/selected, pressed, disabled and focus ring; active indicator (underline/pill) colour and thickness; badge on tab; fold/overflow button; gap; radius per style (underline, pills, boxed, segmented, plain, chips); transparency (default 100%).
